name: How do commercial renovations differ from residential renovations?

mainEntity.name: How do commercial renovations differ from residential renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial renovations differ from residential primarily in scale, regulatory requirements, and functional considerations. Commercial projects often involve stricter building codes, ADA compliance, and specialized HVAC or electrical systems to support business operations. The focus is on functionality, durability, and creating an efficient workspace or customer-facing environment, often with minimal disruption to business hours.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial renovations differ by stricter codes, ADA compliance, specialized systems, and focus on business functionality with minimal disruption.
